'''Galven circuits''',<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> also referred to as '''galven circuitry''', were [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] components.<ref name="CRFG" /> Laid into a blaster's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], the galven circuits further focused the blaster beam as it left the [[prismatic crystal housing]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The [[Luxan Personal Armaments, Ltd.]] [[Penetrator MB-450]] used a series of precision galven circuits that concentrated the blaster beam into a more powerful and highly concentrated discharge.<ref name="GFT" />

The ''[[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|Enforcer One]]'', [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], was armed with a fixed heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] modified with experimental galven circuitry.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
